Hi Priya,

We just downloaded the Redwood Inference benchmark report (very useful — thanks!). I lead ML infra at DeepReport and we’re evaluating options to replace our current inference stack for lower cost and more predictable latency. A quick walkthrough of how Redwood maps to our latency/cost profile would be ideal.

High level:
- Use case: multi-tenant scoring of 3B–7B models, 2k QPS burst, ~1s p95 target
- Current infra: mixed on-prem + GCP TPU/GPU fleet
- Key asks: quantization support, batching strategy, and how fallbacks work during capacity pressure

Would you have 30–45 minutes this week for a demo + short onboarding conversation? Prefer mornings PST. I’ve attached the benchmark we ran for context.

Thanks,
Marta Lopez
Head of ML Infrastructure, DeepReport
Attachments: deepreport-benchmark.pdf (report, 2.3 MB)
